notes: The native HLA_EVOKED role-transition test passed before translation. The portable cases use only the official RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs to observe an unserviced Enable Time Regulation or Enable Time Constrained request, the corresponding pending-request exception from TAR and a repeated enable, then exactly one enable callback and a successful disable. Direct Lab mappings are limited to role requests and callbacks (§§8.2, 8.3.1, 8.5.5), role disablement (§§8.4, 8.7.5), and the TAR service (§8.8.3). Exact exception classes are checked as official API-contract details; they are not promoted as separate normative Lab statements. Adapter supplies provider, FOM, endpoint, callback model, and logical time. The pending phase is HLA_EVOKED-only; this does not claim HLA_IMMEDIATE pending behavior or conformance.
